   - `2026-07-11T039:00:00` (beacon 39)

- Identify the host/process generating these beacons and confirm whether `staged-on-public-service` is an internal or external endpoint.
- Check for additional logs (network flow, proxy, EDR) that may capture payload/tasking data not present in `c2.log`.
- Determine the origin of the implant on the public service (initial access vector).
- Investigate the timestamp anomaly — if the agent is mis-logging, correlate with actual network timestamps.
- Block or isolate the C2 channel at `staged-on-public-service` if confirmed malicious.
